patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I tripped on the rug and bumped my head — barely anything, I feel completely fine. My wife made me come in. Oh, I take that blood thinner, warfarin, for my heart rhythm.
presentation.triageNote: 78-year-old male taking warfarin for atrial fibrillation after a ground-level fall with a head strike. He feels well, has a GCS of 15, and has no focal neurological deficit.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 2 is appropriate because head trauma in a patient taking warfarin is high risk despite a normal examination and minimal symptoms.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This anticoagulated older adult struck his head in a fall but currently has normal alertness and no focal neurologic deficit.
clinical.acuityReason: Anticoagulation raises the risk of immediate or delayed intracranial bleeding, so a reassuring appearance cannot justify delay.
expectedResources: Immediate neurologic assessment and serial checks
Reversal treatment and specialty consultation if bleeding is found
teachingPoints: Minor mechanisms can cause clinically important intracranial hemorrhage in anticoagulated patients.
Delayed deterioration instructions and an anticoagulation plan are essential even if initial imaging is reassuring.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Urgent CT and observation planning would be followed by reversal and admission if bleeding is present, or carefully instructed discharge when evaluation remains reassuring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: 78-year-old man, well-dressed, a small bruise on his forehead
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting comfortably, looking mildly annoyed at being here
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a black 78-year-old man, well-dressed, with a small bruise on his forehead, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting comfortably, arms relaxed, looking mildly annoyed to be here. Expression: calm and a little exasperated. Clearly visible: a small bruise on the forehead; he otherwise looks completely well. No text, no logos.
